newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major - future prosperity needs tough decisions.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major - future prosperity needs tough decisions.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Tuesday that the British economy was currently "extremely healthy" but said prosperity could only be sustained by continuing to take difficult decisions in the future.
"It will need difficult decisions in the future just as in the past to maintain that prosperity," Major said at the first of a number of presidential-style press conferences in London.
"There is, therefore, an economic risk and we believe we know what that risk would lead to. It would lead to higher inflation, more unemployment, higher taxes and a lower level of prosperity."
